name: Patriarch

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 4 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Living Idol
bonuses.text: Any Threats with GENESTEALER CULT within 10 metres gain +2 bonus to all Tests.

bonuses.name: Second Strike
bonuses.text: This Threat reduces the Multi-Attack penalty by 2DN, as though is had the Dual Wield Talent (Wrath & Glory, page 133).

abilities.name: Swift and Deadly
abilities.text: The Threat Seizes the Initiative without spending a point of Ruin and Charges. It gains an additional +1 bonus die to its attack Test as part of the Charge.
The Patriarch may use its Broodmind and Monstrous Rending Claws without suffering the -2DN Multi-Attack penalty.

abilities.name: Broodmind
abilities.text: The Patriarch may attempt to activate any of the following psychic powers: Smite (Wrath & Glory, page 272), Psyniscience (page 267), Deny the Witch (page 267), Compel (page 268), Fog the Mind (page 279), Psychic Shriek (page 279), Terrify (page 280).

abilities.name: Broodmind
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Patriarch attempts to activate a Psychic Power, or Deny the Witch.

determination: Lightning Reflexes: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 8D6. This Threat can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds
note: Reprint of genestealer-patriarch; differs in name, keywords (no PSYKER), Tier row (adds Tier 5), and text. Printed 'Monstrous Rending Claws' in the ACTION text, 'Patriarch's Claws' in the profile.
